hooks.command: notify-send -a 'Claude Code' 'Claude Code ✅' 'Task complete — ready for your input' 2>/dev/null; paplay /usr/share/sounds/freedesktop/stereo/complete.oga 2>/dev/null; true

MSG=$(python3 -c "import sys,json;s=sys.stdin.read().strip();d=json.loads(s) if s else {};print(d.get('message','Claude needs your input'))" 2>/dev/null); notify-send -u critical -a 'Claude Code' 'Claude Code ❓' "$MSG" 2>/dev/null; paplay /usr/share/sounds/freedesktop/stereo/message.oga 2>/dev/null; true
